fullDescription: A high-energy, dark-themed portfolio design system featuring a 'rave neon brutalist' aesthetic. It combines massive editorial typography, vibrant red neon accents (#FF1744), and interactive 3D elements. Optimized for DJs, 3D creators, motion designers, and creative agencies, the design utilizes a high-contrast palette, bento-inspired project layouts, triple-row parallax marquees, and sophisticated scroll-triggered animations. Key visual traits include sticky stacking cards, magnetic hover effects, and a bold mix of black, white, and coral-red gradients.

structured.summary: A bold, rave-inspired portfolio design with massive brutalist typography, neon-red accents, and multi-layered parallax scrolling. It transitions from a dark-mode immersive hero to a clean, high-contrast white services section, ending with a sticky project card gallery.

style.description: The style is 'Neon Brutalism'—heavy on high-impact typography and saturated red accents. It uses the Kanit font family (weights 300 to 900) for an athletic yet modern feel. Primary color is Deep Black (#0C0C0C), with accents in Electric Red (#FF1744) and Coral (#E74C3C). Interactive elements feature neon glows (filter: drop-shadow), 3D magnetic transforms, and smooth cubic-bezier transitions.
style.prompt: Create a design system with a 'Neon Rave' aesthetic. Colors: Background #0C0C0C, Primary Accent #FF1744 (Electric Red), Secondary Accent #E74C3C, Text #D7E2EA, Contrast Background #FFFFFF. Typography: Use 'Kanit' font family; Headings are font-black (900), uppercase, tracking-tight, and sized between 12vw to 18vw using CSS clamp. Micro-interactions: Use magnetic transforms for images (multiplier 0.1, scale 1.02), inner shadows for buttons (inset 4px 4px 12px rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.8)), and drop-shadow glows for hover states (0 0 15px rgba(255, 23, 68, 0.4)). Animations: All scroll reveals use cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1) with a 0.8s duration. Service items should feature a 1px border with a 0.02 opacity red hover tint.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical scroll layout organized by thematic sections: Hero with split navigation, Triple-row Parallax Marquee, Decorative Floating About section, High-Contrast White Service List, and Sticky Project Gallery.

prompts.prompt: Layout a split navigation: two links on the left, two on the right, with a central space for the hero image. The hero heading should be massive (17.5vw), uppercase, and centered behind a magnetic portrait image that has a rounded-t-[300px] shape. Footer of hero contains a call-to-action button (pill-shaped, neon-glow) and a short professional bio (max-w 280px).

Design a three-row marquee section. Row 1: Images scrolling RIGHT (parallax offset scrollY * 0.4). Row 2: Images scrolling LEFT (negative offset). Row 3: Images scrolling RIGHT. Each image must be 420px by 270px, rounded-2xl, and featuring a gap of 0.75rem. Add a neon-red drop-shadow filter to all images on hover.

Create a centered text block for the 'About' section using font-medium and 1.4rem size. Decorate the section with four absolute-positioned icons in the corners: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right. These icons should have staggered fade-in animations (delays 0.1s to 0.3s) and move slightly on scroll.

Transition to a #FFFFFF background with #0C0C0C text. Header is centered, font-black, clamp(3rem, 12vw, 160px). Create a list of 5 service items. Each item includes a large numeral (01-05) at 9vw with 20% opacity, a semi-bold title, and a light-weight description. Items are separated by 1px light borders and expand slightly on hover.

Implement a stacking card layout where each project card is 80vh-85vh high and becomes sticky (top: 5rem, 7rem, 9rem for consecutive cards). Each card has a 2px #FF1744 border and #0C0C0C background. Layout inside cards: top section with project number (accent red), title, and 'Live Project' pill button; bottom section with a 12-column grid displaying three project images (one large spanning 7 cols, two stacked spanning 5 cols).

special_ui_components.description: An interactive container that pulls toward the mouse cursor.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a JS-driven magnetic effect: Calculate the center of the component, find the distance from the cursor (threshold 400px), and apply a `translate3d` transform using 10% of that distance. Add `scale(1.02)` and a smooth transition: `transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)`.

special_ui_components.description: High-visibility CTA with inner and outer glows.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a pill-shaped button with a gradient background: `linear-gradient(123deg, #1A0C2E 7%, #FF1744 37%, #DC143C 72%, #E74C3C 100%)`. Add an `outline: 2px solid white` with `outline-offset: -3px`. The shadow should be a multi-layered glow: `box-shadow: 0px 4px 20px rgba(255, 23, 68, 0.4), inset 4px 4px 12px rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.8)`.
